findings.title: Weak title screen menu affordance
findings.problem: The 'New Driver' / 'Controls' list uses a thin border, tiny text, and no clear button styling, so it reads like debug output rather than interactive menu options.
findings.why: Players may not instantly recognize how to start or navigate the menu, harming first‑impression and discoverability.
findings.fix: Redesign the menu as prominent buttons (e.g. larger padded rectangles with solid background and hover/focus states), increase text size and item spacing, and move it closer to the center or a conventional menu area.

findings.title: Visible debug toggles
findings.where: Arena, Road, and City screens, bottom‑right corner
findings.problem: The unstyled 'Reduced flash: off' and 'Reduced shake: off' toggles are always visible, crowding the HUD with debug information.
findings.why: It breaks immersion and signals an unfinished debug build, distracting players from core gameplay elements.
findings.fix: Remove these toggles from the live HUD or relocate them into a collapsible 'Options' or 'Accessibility' menu that players can open when needed.

findings.title: Low-contrast route progress bar
findings.where: Road and City screens, top‑center status bar
findings.problem: The thin white progress bar on a muted background track blends into the environment and is hard to see at a glance.
findings.why: Players lose quick feedback on journey progress, making it difficult to plan stops or gauge remaining distance.
findings.fix: Increase the bar’s thickness to at least 4px, use a high‑contrast fill color or gradient for the traveled portion, and add a darker outline or background track behind it.

findings.title: Unlabeled city map markers
findings.where: City screen, colored arrows and building icons around the car
findings.problem: Colored arrows above buildings have no on‑screen labels or hover tooltips, and the tiny corner legend is too small to quickly associate icons with actions.
findings.why: Players cannot easily interpret which buildings correspond to fights, jobs, repairs, or shops, hindering navigation and decision‑making.
findings.fix: Enlarge and reposition the legend adjacent to the map, add inline text labels or hover tooltips on each icon, and ensure arrow shapes/colors match the legend exactly.

findings.title: Dense constructor UI & subtle inputs
findings.where: Constructor screen, left panel listing parts and weapons
findings.problem: Rows of parts and weapon slots are tightly packed with no separators, and the 'Name' input uses only a thin outline, making fields hard to find and edit.
findings.why: Players struggle to scan groupings, see which row is selected, and notice editable fields, slowing down the vehicle‑building process.
findings.fix: Introduce clear section headers ('Name', 'Chassis/Suspension/Plant', 'Weapons'), increase vertical spacing between rows, insert visual dividers between groups, apply a filled background to the input field, and highlight the active row with a contrasting fill.
